identity.real_world_identity_notes: Le Mans-winning GT1 car with a carbon monocoque and a water-cooled 3.2 litre flat six derived from the 962. For 1998 Porsche fitted a new six-speed sequential gearbox to cut shift times, which matches the six gears and sequential lever seen in the cockpit.

wheel_rim.notes: Observed from the cockpit during the guided drive.

notes: Simulator behavior was directly observed in a guided drive with automatic clutch and shifting disabled.
The clutch is required to move off, and the gear lever is a sequential stick rather than paddles.

In AMS2, no throttle lift is required on upshifts because a full-throttle clutchless upshift was accepted with automatic cut detected. No automatic blip was detected, so that implementation requires the driver to supply the downshift blip; the real car's blip technique remains unknown.
'Porsche 911 GT1-98 - Low Downforce' inherits these verified base controls as an approved aero-package assumption and was not separately live-tested.
Observed live in AMS2 1.6.9.91 via guided verification observation ams2.porsche-911-gt1-98.20260813t195737728z-58cdca22 by Jason Kinslow.

overrides.condition: AMS2 1.6.9.91 requires driver-supplied rev matching for the modeled downshift.
AMS2 1.6.9.91 produced no automatic throttle spike on the tested downshift.

confidence.basis: Simulator behavior was live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled, and the 1998 six-speed sequential gearbox is supported by a registered secondary source.

notes: Observed live in AC 14923034 via guided verification observation ac.porsche-911-gt1-98.20260822t162709160z-6a1d7df8 by Jason Kinslow.

overrides.condition: AC build 14923034 accepted the full-throttle upshift but published no engine torque, so the guided workflow cannot determine whether the implementation cuts ignition.

confidence.basis: The absence of the required torque channel is directly recorded in the immutable guided observation; repeating the drive cannot establish the cut through current telemetry.

overrides.condition: AC build 14923034 accepted the tested clutchless coast downshift without throttle input and showed no automatic throttle spike.

confidence.basis: The guided coast-downshift test directly observed acceptance without a driver blip.

overrides.condition: AC build 14923034 produced no automatic throttle spike on the tested downshift.

confidence.basis: Kunos's official Porsche Pack II material, v1.10 announcement, exact in-game title and ks_porsche_911_gt1 content id establish the 1998 car. The guided drive directly established six sequential-stick gears, clutch-required move-off, full-throttle and coast-shift acceptance, no automatic blip, and cockpit wheel details. Automatic cut is deliberately unknown because AC exposed no engine-torque channel.

claims.basis: Porsche Museum's exact GT1-98 data sheet establishes the sequential six-speed gearbox but gives no driver rev-match or automatic-blip procedure. Simulator implementation behavior is not real-car evidence.
Porsche Museum establishes the 1998 GT1-98 identity and its new six-speed sequential gearbox, and the exact simulator identity was observed live.
